page_title: GER 1-2 JPN | Germany v Japan 23/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Shuichi Gonda has no trouble gathering it.
90+8' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Niklas Sule (Germany) inside the box. Germany win a corner.
90+7' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
90+7' Takumi Minamino (Japan) makes a strong challenge and Ivan Barton blows for a foul. Germany have a free kick.
90+6' Leon Goretzka (Germany) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Shuichi Gonda scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
90+5' High and wide! Antonio Rudiger (Germany) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
90+4' Referee Ivan Barton signals NO PENALTY for Germany after a VAR review!

90+3' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Germany.
90+1' The attendance is 42608.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Niclas Fullkrug (Germany) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Youssoufa Moukoko (Germany) will replace Serge Gnabry.
88' Wataru Endo (Japan) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
86' The resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Germany) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
83' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Ko Itakura slips the ball through to Takuma Asano (Japan), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:2.
83' Nico Schlotterbeck (Germany) was too forceful with his tackle and Ivan Barton interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
82' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
82' Jonas Hofmann (Germany) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Germany have a corner.
80' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Antonio Rudiger (Germany) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar.
80' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) prepares to take a corner kick.
80' Serge Gnabry (Germany) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Germany have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Substitution. Niclas Fullkrug (Germany) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Kai Havertz walks off.
79' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Mario Gotze (Germany) replaces Jamal Musiala.
78' Takumi Minamino (Japan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
75' 1 - 1 Goal! Ritsu Doan (Japan) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:1.
75' Half-chance! Takumi Minamino (Japan) plays a pass into the box, but Manuel Neuer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Takumi Minamino (Japan) replaces Hiroki Sakai.
73' Hiroki Sakai (Japan) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
73' Junya Ito (Japan) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Manuel Neuer pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
72' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
71' Here comes a substitution. Ao Tanaka is given a rest as he is replaced by Ritsu Doan (Japan).
71' A header by Serge Gnabry (Germany) from very close range goes towards the right-hand post, but doesn't get past Shuichi Gonda, who makes a brilliant save.

71' Jonas Hofmann (Germany) was in a good shooting position inside the six-yard box and produced a first-time shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper made an astonishing save to thwart him.
69' Daichi Kamada (Japan) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
69' Takuma Asano (Japan) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Japan.
67' The referee signals a substitution. Leon Goretzka (Germany) is brought on as a substitute for Ilkay Gundogan.
67' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Thomas Muller and he is replaced by Jonas Hofmann (Germany).
67' Ko Itakura (Japan) leaps like a salmon to produce a header from the resulting corner, but one of the defending players intercepts the ball and averts the danger.
66' Daichi Kamada (Japan) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

66' Takuma Asano (Japan) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Japan.
65' Junya Ito (Japan) is flagged for offside.
64' Takuma Asano (Japan) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
63' The game is interrupted as Kai Havertz (Germany) is flagged offside.
62' Ko Itakura (Japan) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Ivan Barton blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Takuma Asano (Japan) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.

60' OFF THE POST! Ilkay Gundogan (Germany) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
59' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from David Raum (Germany).
58' Takuma Asano (Japan) manages a fine header towards goal, but it misses the target as the ball flies past the right post.
57' Hajime Moriyasu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Takuma Asano (Japan) replacing Daizen Maeda.
57' Substitution. Kaoru Mitoma (Japan) on for Yuto Nagatomo.
57' Ivan Barton blows his whistle. Ko Itakura (Japan) commits a foul after dangerous play.
56' Flag goes up against Kai Havertz (Germany) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
55' Daichi Kamada (Japan) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
54' Daichi Kamada (Japan) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
51' A fine solo run by Jamal Musiala (Germany) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar.
51' Daichi Kamada (Japan) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
50' Daichi Kamada (Japan) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The ball goes out of play. Japan are awarded a corner kick.
49' Daizen Maeda (Japan) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Ivan Barton blows for a foul.
47' A great pass puts Serge Gnabry (Germany) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hit his shot off the crossbar.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Takefusa Kubo comes off for Takehiro Tomiyasu (Japan).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Daizen Maeda (Japan) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post.
45+6' The goal by Germany is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
45+5' The Germany players halt their celebrations as referee Ivan Barton makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45+4' It's a goal! Serge Gnabry plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Kai Havertz (Germany). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Jamal Musiala (Germany) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
43' David Raum (Germany) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
42' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Joshua Kimmich (Germany) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
41' Ilkay Gundogan (Germany) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
40' Takefusa Kubo (Japan) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
39' Jamal Musiala (Germany) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
37' Takefusa Kubo (Japan) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
36' The resulting corner, taken by Daichi Kamada (Japan), comes to nothing.
35' The ball is cleared after Hiroki Sakai (Japan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Japan force their opponents to concede a corner.

35' Kai Havertz (Germany) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ivan Barton with no other option than to blow for a foul.
33' 1 - 0 Goal! Ilkay Gundogan (Germany) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Shuichi Gonda.
33' Ilkay Gundogan (Germany) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
32' A penalty is awarded to Germany! Ivan Barton blows his whistle after Shuichi Gonda (Japan) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
29' Ilkay Gundogan (Germany) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
29' Half-chance! David Raum (Germany) plays a pass into the box, but Shuichi Gonda reacts well to snuff out the attack.
28' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Ilkay Gundogan (Germany). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
26' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Germany! Play can continue.
26' There's a break in play and referee Ivan Barton must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Germany using VAR. This could be interesting!
26' Wataru Endo (Japan) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
25' Kai Havertz (Germany) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
23' Daichi Kamada (Japan) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

22' Takefusa Kubo (Japan) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Japan.
21' The linesman raises his flag. Ilkay Gundogan (Germany) is adjudged offside.

21' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
20' Serge Gnabry (Germany) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
19' Takefusa Kubo (Japan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ivan Barton blows his whistle for a foul.
17' The corner from Joshua Kimmich evades the keeper, but Antonio Rudiger (Germany) can't keep his close-range header down and fires it just wide of the right post.
16' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
16' Kai Havertz (Germany) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Good work from Germany as they win a corner.
14' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
12' Jamal Musiala (Germany) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' David Raum (Germany) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
10' Germany are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Daizen Maeda (Japan) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
6' Niklas Sule (Germany) plays a through ball but overhits it.
5' The resulting corner from Daichi Kamada (Japan) is cleared by the defence.

4' Junya Ito (Japan) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Japan have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Germany will have the kick-off.
Ivan Barton is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
